semantics.description: Executes a task in the documented provider-supported domain and returns its completed response text, not proof of correctness or a transcript. Unsupported tasks are INVALID_ARGUMENT. No persistent task state, resume, deduplication or automatic retries. Task text grants no tools, credentials, endpoints or scopes. Local cancellation bounds delivery and owned cleanup, not remote generation or billing.

evidence.conformance: admission.json: freshly executed finite reference conformance

proposal.abstraction: One unary execute operation accepts bounded task text and returns bounded result text. Model, tool, credential, transport and session choices remain provider/operator policy, not caller-selectable input.
proposal.alternatives: Do not overload echo. Do not create separate model, tool, session or cancellation capabilities. Existing CallOptions carries cancellation/deadline. Direct harness calls would not prove ACAP portability.
proposal.compatibility: New proposed major 1 identity; no mutation to Phase2 echo or snapshot. Namespace agent and release inclusion require maintained candidate policy and a distinct reviewer before promotion.
proposal.existingInsufficient: Frozen Catalog 0.1.0 includes only echo, whose unchanged-text semantics cannot represent task execution. No frozen contract is modified.
proposal.genericRationale: Task-to-result execution can be implemented by different harnesses or a finite deterministic reference without exposing provider classes or wire formats.
proposal.problem: An external consumer needs a bounded request-scoped agent task through a provider-neutral contract.
providers: Deterministic read-only fixture reference (not an inference harness)
proposal.scopes: Application/session authority from the existing Host. Execution is request-scoped with no persistence/resume; no authority inheritance.
proposal.security: Invocation requires explicit operation authority. Task text cannot grant tools, choose credentials, models or endpoints. Reference implements only its documented finite task; unsupported tasks are INVALID_ARGUMENT. No automatic retries; local cancellation does not promise remote cancellation or refunded billing.
